concerns.text: SC-001 requires measuring the processed‑prompt completion rate (≥ 95 %). No task computes or verifies this metric, so the acceptance criterion is dropped.
Spec edge case mandates retry with exponential backoff on MedMisBench download failures. T013 only states “fail loudly” and does not implement any retry logic, weakening the requirement.
Spec requires programmatic retrieval of the baseline ASR from the ACL 2024 paper. T045‑ExtractBaseline hard‑codes the value 0.42 after verification, violating the requirement for automated retrieval.
